lyrics:
[Intro: bus door hiss, engine, one sustained synth note]

[Announcement: calm recorded female voice]
Next stop. Please hold the rail.

[Riff A: distorted synth riff, double-time drums]

[Riff B: higher arpeggio, bass octave jumps]

[Announcement: same voice, pitch bending]
Next stop. Next stop.

[Riff A: heavier, with tom rolls]

[Break: church organ alone, engine idling]

[Build: snare roll, siren synth rising]

[Riff C: fastest, lead synth solo, choir pad]

[Announcement: distorted]
Next stop.

[Outro: tyres, a long brake squeal, door hiss]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 150 BPM, 4/4, D minor. Fast, aggressive and cinematic, a chase on synthesizers.

VOICE: Instrumental. A calm, recorded woman's public-transport voice speaks three short announcements, cleanly at first and then bent in pitch and distorted.

INSTRUMENTS: Heavily distorted sawtooth synths playing fast palm-mute-style riffs, a driving synth bass in octaves, double-time drums with a gated snare and rolling toms, a pipe organ in the break, a screaming lead synth solo, a choir pad, bus doors, engine and brakes.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, doors and engine. 0:10 Announcement. 0:16 Riff A. 0:44 Riff B. 1:10 Announcement. 1:16 Riff A, heavier. 1:42 Break, organ. 2:00 Build. 2:12 Riff C, fastest. 2:48 Announcement, distorted. 2:54 Outro, brakes and doors, ends 3:18.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Mid-2010s darksynth: 1980s horror-film synths with modern metal loudness, compressed and saturated.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The church organ dropping in alone at 1:42.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original's killer drives a muscle car. This vehicle has no driver at all, only a pleasant voice that keeps announcing stops it does not make.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Uneasy, accelerating, a held breath, flat out.
